description: One primary action welded to a chevron trigger that opens a menu of related alternatives, bound into a single role="group" widget.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
When `true`, Root delegates rendering to a single consumer-supplied
element via the {@link Slot } pattern instead of the default `<div>`;
`role="group"`, `data-state`, `data-disabled` and the remaining props are
merged onto it.

props.name: children
props.description:
The widget's parts — typically one
{@link SplitButtonActionProps`SplitButton.Action`}, one
{@link SplitButtonTriggerProps`SplitButton.Trigger`}, and one
{@link SplitButtonMenuProps`SplitButton.Menu`}.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
Whether the menu is open on first render. Omit to start closed. The
component owns the state thereafter.
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `open` instead.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Reading direction for the menu. Only affects which arrow key opens or
closes a submenu composed from `Dropdown.Sub` — `ArrowRight` opens in
`"ltr"`, `ArrowLeft` in `"rtl"`. When omitted it is inherited from the
nearest {@link DirectionProvider }, falling back to `"ltr"`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disables the whole widget — both the primary action and the menu trigger
become non-interactive, and `data-disabled=""` is set on the group. OR-ed
with each half's own `disabled`, so a disabled group can never be
overridden back to enabled by a part.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called whenever a user-driven transition opens or closes the menu
(trigger click, `ArrowDown` on the action, Escape, outside click,
selection). Optional in uncontrolled mode.
Called whenever a user-driven transition would open or close the menu. The
parent is responsible for reflecting the new value back into `open`.
Required in controlled mode.

props.name: open
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — use `defaultOpen` instead.
Whether the menu is currently open. Must be kept in sync by the parent via
`onOpenChange`; the component never mutates it internally.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
Forwarded to the underlying `HTMLDivElement` (or to the `asChild`
element).

contractProps.name: variant
contractProps.description: Visual intent, applied to both halves. Ghost and link are deliberately unavailable — neither has a box at rest for the seam to divide.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Control size, applied to both halves and the menu; `data-density` scales each size further.

api.description:
`<primitiv-split-button>` — one primary action welded to a menu of related alternatives (WAI-ARIA APG Button + Menu Button), bound into a single `role="group"`. It holds two things the consumer writes: a `<primitiv-split-button-action>` around the action's `<button>`, and a `<primitiv-dropdown>` whose trigger is the chevron half and whose content is the menu — so the menu's whole behaviour, and its `open` state and events, are the dropdown's.

What the group adds: ArrowDown on the action opens the menu (through the trigger, so the dropdown's change event still fires), `data-state` mirroring the menu, a `disabled` that disables both halves, and the trigger's accessible name — unless the trigger carries `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, it is named by its own content then the action's (`aria-labelledby="<trigger id> <action id>"`), so a visually hidden "More options" reads as "More options, Squash and merge". Defining it defines the Dropdown elements too.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables both halves: native `disabled` and `data-disabled` on each button. To disable one half alone, put `disabled` on its part — `<primitiv-split-button-action>` or `<primitiv-dropdown-trigger>` — not on the button, which the group owns.

api.description: `<primitiv-split-button-action>` — an interactive part: the primary half. It decorates exactly one child the consumer writes, a `<button>` (or a link), which keeps its own click and gets `data-split-button-action`, an id if it has none, and ArrowDown to open the menu.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the action half alone (native `disabled` and `data-disabled` on its button).
